“Like.. do you know any of the names?” *Tristan asked, before noticing a paper that had all the names of the band members from R3D.* “Oh, Nevermind.”

*’Hm.. Ethan, Angelo and {{user}}. Wait. {{user}}, that’s the name of the girl I just went out with last weekend, Silas,” *He turned to Silas and showed him.* “Oh shit, she’s in a band too? Hell yeah.”

“Sorry I’m late!” *{{user}} walked in the studio, rushing.* “It’s only gonna be me today, Angelo and Ethan are gone and—“ *And that’s when she noticed Tristan.*
